checks.name: row number per partition
checks.sql: SELECT id, grp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY score DESC, id) AS rn FROM scores ORDER BY id;

checks.name: lag lead defaults
checks.sql: SELECT id, score, LAG(score, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY id) AS prev_score, LEAD(score, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY id) AS next_score FROM scores ORDER BY id;

checks.name: named window reference
checks.sql: SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER w AS rn FROM scores WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id;

checks.name: running rows frame
checks.sql: SELECT id, grp, SUM(score) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum FROM scores ORDER BY id;

checks.name: grouped rows plus window
checks.sql: SELECT grp, SUM(score) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(score) DESC) AS rn FROM scores GROUP BY grp ORDER BY grp;

checks.name: range frame unsupported
checks.sql: SELECT id, SUM(score) OVER (ORDER BY id RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum FROM scores;
checks.expected_error: RANGE window frames are not supported yet
